blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Monday said it was “obvious” who was allegedly behind threats against members of the minority, while his sister, Sen. Pia Cayetano, separately raised concerns over intimidation against senator-judges during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. “It’s obvious, isn’t it, guys? It’s obvious, you can see it with your eyes,” Cayetano told reporters in an ambush interview. Cayetano then named Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson as an example, saying, “When Senator Ping, for example, says that the impeachment should be finished by December. Then, by December, they say I’ll have a […]...
